The ID of the domain name instance configuration. You can configure both A and AAAA records for the same access domain name and the same GTM instance at the same time. In this case, two domain name instance configurations are generated for the same GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a domain name instance configuration.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2797349.html operation to query the ConfigId of a domain name instance

AddressPoolLbStrategy.description_en:
The load balancing policy among address pools. Valid values:

round_robin: round-robin. For DNS queries from any source, all address pools are returned, and the address pools are rotated and sorted each time.

sequence: sequence. For DNS queries from any source, the address pool with the smaller sequence number is returned. The sequence number indicates the priority of the address pool. A smaller sequence number indicates a higher priority. If the address pool with the smaller sequence number is unavailable, the address pool with the next smaller sequence number is returned.

weight: weight. You can set different weight values for each address pool to return address pools based on the weight ratio for DNS queries.

source_nearest: nearest access. This is the intelligent DNS resolution feature. GTM can return different address pools based on the source of the DNS query to achieve nearest access for users
AddressPoolLbStrategy.description_zh:
地址池之间的负载均衡策略：

round_robin：轮询，对于任何来源的解析请求，返回所有地址池。并且每次对于所有地址池进行轮转排序；

sequence：顺序，对于任何来源的解析请求，返回顺序号较小的地址池（顺序号标识地址池返回的优先级，越小优先级越高）。若顺序号较小的地址池不可用时，返回下一个序号较小的地址池。

weight：权重，支持对每个地址池设置不同的权重值，实现解析查询按照权重比例返回地址池。

source_nearest：来源就近，即智能解析功能，GTM可以根据不同的解析请求来源返回不同的地址池，实现用户就近访问的效果
AddressPoolLbStrategy.title_en: 地址池的负载均衡策略
AddressPoolLbStrategy.title_zh: 地址池的负载均衡策略

AvailableStatus.description_en:
The service availability status of the domain name instance. Valid values:

available: available. The domain name is enabled and its health status is normal. The service availability status of the access domain name is available.

unavailable: unavailable. The domain name is disabled or its health status is abnormal. The service availability status of the access domain name is unavailable
AvailableStatus.description_zh:
域名实例服务可用状态：

available：可用，域名启用且健康状态为正常，接入域名的服务可用状态为可用。

unavailable：不可用，域名禁用或健康状态为异常，接入域名的服务可用状态为不可用

dns_gtm_public_cn: the commodity code for the China site.

dns_gtm_public_intl: the commodity code for the international site

商品编码：

dns_gtm_public_cn：中国站商品编码。

dns_gtm_public_intl：国际站商品编码

ConfigId.description_en:
The ID of the domain name instance configuration.
If the same access domain name and the same GTM instance are configured with both A and AAAA records, two domain name instance configurations are generated for the GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a domain name instance configuration
ConfigId.description_zh:
域名实例配置ID。
相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置

CreateTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of when the instance was created

EnableStatus.description_en:
The enablement status of the domain name instance. Valid values:

enable: enabled. The intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance takes effect.

disable: disabled. The intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance is unavailable
EnableStatus.description_zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

enable：启用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略生效。

disable：禁用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略不可用

HealthStatus.description_en:
The health status of the domain name instance. Valid values:

ok: normal. All address pools referenced by the access domain name are available.

ok_alert: warning. Some address pools referenced by the access domain name are unavailable. In the warning state, available address pools are resolved normally, and unavailable address pools stop being resolved.

exceptional: abnormal. All address pools referenced by the access domain name are unavailable. In this case, addresses in the non-empty address pool with the smaller sequence number referenced by the instance are used for fallback resolution to help the client obtain the resolution result as much as possible
HealthStatus.description_zh:
域名实例健康状态：

ok：正常，接入域名引用的所有地址池全部可用。

ok_alert：警告，接入域名引用的所有地址池部分不可用。警告状态下，可用的地址池正常解析，不可用的地址池停止解析。

exceptional：异常，接入域名引用的所有地址池全部不可用。此时，使用实例所引用的顺序号较小的非空地址池中的地址进行兜底解析，尽可能帮助客户端获得解析结果

ScheduleDomainName.description_en: The GTM access domain name. The format is the host record of the access domain name (the value of the ScheduleHostname parameter) plus the primary domain or subdomain (the value of the ScheduleZoneName parameter)
ScheduleDomainName.description_zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）

ScheduleHostname.description_en: The host record of the GTM access domain name

ScheduleRrType.description_en:
The DNS record type of the scheduling domain name. Valid values:

A: IPv4 address

AAAA: IPv6 address

CNAME: domain name
ScheduleRrType.description_zh:
调度域名的解析记录类型：

A：IPv4地址

AAAA：IPv6地址

CNAME：域名

ScheduleZoneMode.description_en:
The allocation mode for the access domain name. Valid values:

custom: custom access domain name. You can specify a custom host record and associate it with the primary domain or subdomain under the account to which the GTM instance belongs to generate the access domain name.

sys_assign: system-allocated access domain name. This feature is no longer supported. Do not select this mode
ScheduleZoneMode.description_zh:
接入域名分配模式：

custom：自定义接入域名，用户自定义主机记录，并关联GTM实例所在账号下的主域或子域，生成接入域名。

sys_assign：系统默认分配接入域名，本功能已经不支持，请勿选择此模式

ScheduleZoneName.description_en: The primary domain (example.com) or subdomain (a.example.com) of the GTM access domain name. Generally, this is a domain name hosted in the authoritative resolution of the Alibaba Cloud DNS console under the account to which the GTM instance belongs
ScheduleZoneName.description_zh: GTM接入域名的主域（example.com）或子域（a.example.com）。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台权威解析中托管的域名

SequenceLbStrategyMode.description_en:
The service mode when a preceding resource recovers from an exception and the load balancing policy among address pools is set to sequence. Valid values:

preemptive: preemptive mode. When the preceding resource recovers, the address pool with the smaller sequence number is preferentially used.

non_preemptive: non-preemptive mode. When the preceding resource recovers, the current address pool is still used
SequenceLbStrategyMode.description_zh:
地址池间负载均衡策略为顺序模式时，前序资源异常恢复服务模式：

preemptive：抢占模式，前序资源恢复，优先使用顺序号较小的地址池。

non_preemptive：非抢占模式，前序资源恢复，仍然使用当前地址池
SequenceLbStrategyMode.title_en: 顺序负载策略模式（抢占式、非抢占式）
SequenceLbStrategyMode.title_zh: 顺序负载策略模式（抢占式、非抢占式）

Ttl.description_en: The global time-to-live (TTL) in seconds. This is the TTL value for resolving the access domain name to the addresses in the address pool. It affects the cache duration of the DNS record in the local DNS of the ISP. Custom TTL values are supported
Ttl.description_zh: 全局TTL（单位：秒），接入域名解析到地址池中地址的TTL值，影响解析记录在运营商LocalDNS中的缓存时间，支持自定义TTL值

UpdateTime.description_zh: 最后一次修改时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of when the instance was last updated
UpdateTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次修改时间（时间戳）
